people.name: Harmon
people.line: A place mentioned in Amos's prophecy against Israel.

translations.web: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You will go out through broken walls, each one straight ahead of her, and you will be cast out toward Harmon,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every one straight before her; and ye shall cast yourselves into Harmon, saith Jehovah.
